description: Failure C — stop memory-injection from displacing the system message on strict chat-template providers (confirmed 18x '[400]/[500]: System message must be at the beginning' in app.log). ROOT CAUSE (confirmed in src/lib/memory/injection.ts): for providers vllm / ollama-local / ollama / llama-cpp, providerSupportsSystemMessage() returns true and systemMessageMustBeFirst() returns false (builtin strict set is only {xiaomi-mimo, mimo, tokenrouter} and OMNIROUTE_STRICT_SYSTEM_PROVIDERS is unset on the deployed instance). With prompt caching active (cacheSafe), injectMemory() -> placeMessage() splices a {role:'system'} memory message mid-array before the last user turn (strategy 'system-cache-safe'), pushing the real system message off index 0; the strict Qwen/GLM/MLX templates then raise the error. FIX: add those provider ids to BUILTIN_PROVIDERS_SYSTEM_MUST_BE_FIRST so they route through injectSystemFirst (merge into messages[0], never mid-array). Agent edits + tests + commits in OmniRoute source. The deployed instance (3.8.50) needs an OPERATOR redeploy of the 3.8.52 source for the fix to reach production; the operator mitigation OMNIROUTE_STRICT_SYSTEM_PROVIDERS=vllm,ollama-local,ollama,llama-cpp,llamacpp + restart gives immediate relief and is documented, not applied by the agent.
steps: In /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/OmniRoute/src/lib/memory/injection.ts, extend BUILTIN_PROVIDERS_SYSTEM_MUST_BE_FIRST (currently new Set(['xiaomi-mimo','mimo','tokenrouter'])) to also include 'vllm', 'ollama-local', 'ollama', 'llama-cpp', 'llamacpp' (cover both hyphenated and unhyphenated spellings observed in /v1/models). Update the adjacent doc comment to note these are the self-hosted strict Qwen/GLM chat-template providers (esnixi 5090 coder, 4070 IQ3 coder, M5 MLX/GLM) added per Failure C.

In src/lib/memory/__tests__/injection.test.ts, add tests asserting that for each new provider id, injectMemory(request-with-leading-system, memories, provider, {cacheSafe:true}) returns messages whose index 0 is a system message whose content STARTS WITH the memory text merged into the original system content, and that NO system-role message exists at any index > 0. Also assert the existing non-strict providers keep the #3890 cache-safe mid-array behavior (regression guard).
Keep the fix additive and typed; do not use `as any`. Run the focused test suite and typecheck.
Commit on OmniRoute branch feat/hybrid-reader-combo (do NOT push).

Document (in reader-fabric-verification.md and the FEAT findings) the OPERATOR immediate mitigation: set OMNIROUTE_STRICT_SYSTEM_PROVIDERS=vllm,ollama-local,ollama,llama-cpp,llamacpp in the deployed instance env and restart `omniroute serve`; and that the permanent fix requires redeploying the 3.8.52 source. The agent does NOT restart the running instance.
